g.text: Initial activity profiles and continuous cue footprints
Grey: basal active profile normalized by its own contrast. Colours: cue shape divided by requested peak; dashed line: basal half contrast.
Physical full support: chemical 3 (27° at C = 40); Spring 0.2 (35.22° at its basal circumference). Native peaks: WP 0.1, Goryachev 6.4, Holmes 1, Spring 4.
All overlap is retained. Overlapping inputs perturb the original activity region; fixed-region depletion cannot identify a separate challenger or site ancestry.
